name: Jausenstation Goingstätt
beschreibung: Jausenstation Goingstätt is an authentic alpine inn located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser. Perched on a sun-drenched plateau above the valley floor, it offers dramatic vistas of the rugged Kaisergebirge mountain peaks. The rustic wooden tavern and breezy outdoor sun terrace provide the perfect respite for hikers and mountain bikers. The menu highlights hearty regional fare, including the traditional cold cuts platter (Brettljause) with farm cheeses and cured bacon, followed by freshly caramelized Kaiserschmarrn pancakes made from local ingredients.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine snack station in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser featuring a sun terrace and local delicacies.
